purpose: Acknowledge an emphasized fact before contrasting it with another.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
N + こそ … が / けれど; Vます stem + こそすれ is separate
It is expensive, admittedly, but it lasts.
The room may be small, but it gets good sunlight.
Its shape is different, but the mechanism is the same.
formation: N + こそ … が / けれど; Vます stem + こそすれ is separate
restrictions: Focuses a limitation while preserving a contrasting positive point.
mistake: こそ supplies emphasis; が or けれど carries the contrast.
